verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official, npm-distributed developer tool, @shopify/ucp-cli, with structured commands covering catalog, cart, checkout, handoff and orders. It also offers the AI Toolkit plugin, and a live probe confirms the CLI creating a real cart. However, the pack never documents an importable client SDK library. The CLI and MCP JSON-RPC endpoints are the official build surface, and the UCP site mentions only generic 'reference implementations' on GitHub. Missing for 10: a documented official SDK library (e.g. JS/Python client packages) with API reference, multi-language coverage, and independent corroboration of SDK usage.
